The Grizzlies defeated the Nets, 129-110 tonight in Memphis. Cedric Coward finished with a team-high 23 points along with 12 rebounds and 4 assists for the Grizzlies, while Taylor Hendricks tallied 22 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Julius Randle recorded 22 points, 5 assists and 4 rebounds. The Grizzlies improve their record to 9-4 with the win, while the Nets fall to 3-9 for the season.
